title: 第29章 你们是匪终究是匪第30章 所有的算计都没有他的刀快
slug: 骂我朝廷鹰犬我乃大秦武圣
content_zh:
姚高和方大河想开口说什么，悲切的唢呐声响起，张远他们将衣衫整理一下，退出灵堂。
送葬的队伍拉了半里地，村子里后辈都来送行。
对于寻常百姓家来说，这已经极尽哀荣。
郑老爷子年过七十，算是喜丧。
送过葬，庄子上开席，张远他们本是要走的，硬被留住。
坐在主桌席位，那些郑家庄上头脸人物都是小心陪着，也不敢央酒。
张远为寻求刀法极致，从不喝酒，陶公子倒是想喝，可被张远瞪一眼，只好摆手拒绝。
吃席时候，说起郑老爷子事情，都说遇到了二爷仁义滔天，若不然三四年前就熬不过去了。
也有说就算郑强还在，老爷子也受不着这等风光大葬。
过片刻，姚高跟方大河端着酒碗走过来，席上其他人忙起身让开。
都晓得他们是匪。
“二爷，我是燎杨镇孔家孔白唐，跟郑老哥是表兄弟，表兄驾鹤，郑某来送最后一程。”两人身后，一位富态老者拱着手，面上都是笑。
陶公子点点头，看一眼两位青山寨来人，再看向孔白唐：“孔家主节哀。”
孔白唐嘴角微微一抽，面上笑容有些僵。
若不是有事求张二爷，他怎么可能来郑家庄，参加八竿子打不着的表兄葬礼？
这节哀，节哪门子哀？
张远只是点头示意，并不搭话招呼。
这让孔白唐有些尴尬。
轻咳一声，他往前走一步，顺势坐到席前：“孔某来见二爷，是有事相商。”
孔白唐自顾自斟一杯酒，端在手里，然后道：“我孔家商队往来三县两镇，也有边境生意。”

“这些年跟青山寨的兄弟们交道打的多，看他们挣这点辛苦钱，实在有些看不过。”
一旁的姚高和方大河眼睛有些发虚的看向张远，见张远神色并无什么变化，方才松一口气。
怎么说呢，孔白唐的话也是真的。
山匪都是做一趟就能大口喝酒大口吃肉，没钱了再下山的日子。
被张远拖下山后，开路，修索道，不准打家劫舍，青山十八寨的人日子过的真是艰难。
这两年庐阳府商道渐渐繁盛，青山寨那些索道，开的山路走的商队才多了，他们也才逐渐滋润起来。
如今倒是不少山寨匪寇羡慕青山寨了。
“是二爷和夫子让我们过上安稳日子。”姚高和方大河忙插嘴，“现在日子本分，也踏实。”
听到两人话，孔白唐轻笑一声。
“我是见兄弟们守着富贵不知，心中焦急。”
说着，他看向张远和陶公子，压低声音：“二爷，我有些路子，可将青山寨造的铁索滑轮卖出去。”
“只要二位能把滑索和滑轮造出来，我就能卖掉。”
伸出手，他手掌摊开：“有多少我收多少，五五分。”
“不，六四也成。”
他一手端着酒杯，面上带着笑意，看着张远和陶公子。
这两位名气不小，他承认。
就凭义薄云天四个字，就是金招牌。
可一个出身草莽，一个不过是落魄书生而已。
之前寻青山寨的人引荐二爷，他还以为二爷是个三十开外四十出头的大汉，不想竟是个毛头小子。
这样的人行事或许讲义气，重情义，可真要说见识，能比得过他掌控一方家族数十年的孔家家主？

就说那铁索和滑轮，青山寨用来修滑道，每日赚些运货辛苦钱。
二爷是真不知道，这等东西能卖出天价啊！
content_en:
Yao Gao and Fang Dahe wanted to say something, but the mournful suona sounded. Zhang Yuan and the others straightened their clothes and exited the mourning hall.
The funeral procession stretched for half a mile, and the younger generations from the village came to see him off.
For ordinary people, this is extremely sad.
Mr. Zheng is over seventy, which is considered a happy occasion.
After the funeral, Zhuangzi went to the banquet. Zhang Yuan and the others wanted to leave, but they were forced to stay.
Sitting at the main table, the prominent figures in the Zheng Family Manor were carefully accompanying him and did not dare to ask for a drink.
Zhang Yuan never drank in order to pursue the ultimate in swordsmanship. Mr. Tao wanted to drink, but Zhang Yuan glared at him and had to wave his hand to refuse.
When we were having dinner, everyone talked about Mr. Zheng. They all said that he met the second master with great benevolence and righteousness. Otherwise, he would not have been able to survive three or four years ago.
It was also said that even if Zheng Qiang was still alive, the old man would not be able to bear such a glorious burial.
After a while, Yao Gao and Fang Dahe came over with wine bowls, and the others at the table hurriedly stood up and moved out of the way.
Everyone knows they are bandits.
"Second Master, I am Kong Baitang of the Kong family in Liaoyang Town. I am my cousin with Brother Zheng. My cousin is riding a crane. Zheng is here to see me off for the last time." Behind the two of them, a rich old man held his hands with a smile on his face.
Mr. Tao nodded, glanced at the two people from Qingshan Village, and then looked at Kong Baitang: "My condolences, Master Kong."
The corners of Kong Baitang's mouth twitched slightly, and the smile on his face was a little stiff.
If he hadn't asked Mr. Zhang for something, how could he have come to Zhengjiazhuang to attend the funeral of his cousin who was beyond his reach?
What kind of mourning is this?
Zhang Yuan just nodded and said nothing.
This made Kong Baitang a little embarrassed.
With a slight cough, he took a step forward and sat down at the table: "Kong came to see the second master to discuss something."
Kong Baitang poured a glass of wine by himself, held it in his hand, and then said: "My Kong family caravan travels between three counties and two towns, and we also have border business."
"I have dealt with the brothers in Qingshan Village a lot over the years. It's really hard to see them earning such hard-earned money."
Yao Gao and Fang Dahe on the side looked at Zhang Yuan with dazzled eyes, and they breathed a sigh of relief when they saw that Zhang Yuan's expression did not change much.
How should I put it? Kong Baitang’s words are also true.
Bandits can drink and eat meat in one trip, and then go back down the mountain when they run out of money.
After being dragged down the mountain by Zhang Yuan, roads were opened, ropeways were built, and houses were not allowed to be robbed. The people of the Qingshan Eighteen Villages lived a really difficult life.
In the past two years, Luyang Prefecture's trade routes have gradually become more prosperous. The ropeways in Qingshan Village have opened more mountain roads for caravans to travel, and they have gradually become more prosperous.
Nowadays, many copycat bandits are envious of Qingshan Village.
"It is the second master and the wife who have allowed us to live a stable life." Yao Gao and Fang Dahe hurriedly interrupted, "Now we are living a stable life."
After hearing what the two said, Kong Baitang chuckled.
"I saw my brothers guarding their wealth without knowing it, and I felt anxious."
As he spoke, he looked at Zhang Yuan and Mr. Tao, and lowered his voice: "Second Master, I have some ways to sell the iron rope pulleys made in Qingshan Village."
"As long as you two can build the zipline and pulley, I can sell it."
Stretching out his hand, he spread his palms and said, "I'll take whatever you have, fifty-fifty."
"No, June 4th will also work."
He held the wine glass in one hand and looked at Zhang Yuan and Mr. Tao with a smile on his face.
These two were quite famous, he admitted.
Just the four words Yi Bo Yuntian are the golden signboard.
But one has a rough background, and the other is just a down-and-out scholar.
When someone from Qingshan Village recommended the second master, he thought he was a big man in his thirties or early forties, but he turned out to be a young boy.
Such a person may act with loyalty and friendship, but can he really be as knowledgeable as the head of the Kong family, who has controlled a family for decades?
Just talk about the iron ropes and pulleys. Qingshan Village uses them to build the slide and earn some hard-earned money from transporting goods every day.
The second master really didn’t know that something like this could be sold for such a high price!
